hypothesis.statement: The first MetaHuman Editor session can silently consume a stale shape, skip human marker correction, or be reported as solved before conform and fixed-view identity review.
hypothesis.action: Build one immutable v002-only session bundle that binds the verified source, preflight, Unreal asset destinations, seven ordered guided stages and Looking Glass Go capture contract.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Installation completion changes only readiness; it cannot bypass source lineage, manual Identity correction, conform evidence or five-view identity rejection.

qualityBoundary: The bundle orchestrates the first real MetaHuman session but contains no solved Identity, DNA, production face, or AAA-quality evidence.
decision: Use this bundle after preflight becomes ready. Reject the first conform if canonical 03/06/07/08 comparisons retain the unattractive MPFB proportions.
